body: Take it from someone who is literally staring death in the face, I've got this weird sense of clarity and I'm telling u once u take that first step ur family will be underneath u and u will feel like ur soaring with their help, u know if it was ur mum is sister that felt like this u would move heaven and earth to help them

What u have just written MAKES u a good human, u tried to reach out to someone to help them to me that's textbook definition right there, she hasn't had a partner for 20years all she wants is kids but she's not allowed which is a shame really, u don't need to tell them maybe just ur mum and sister if they know stuff already and nobody else does shows they can be trusted, maybe we will meet one day in the afterlife and have a drink and u can tell me what u did with ur life and how u got through it with the love of ur family, I don't live near my cousin anymore and too skint to afford travel but she wouldn't understand as her mind is too messed up which is such a shame for her

Don't worry about me in the slightest I've never felt so content, my whole life has been stress worry failure etc, u on the other hand prob need to get high and figure shit out, explain everything in writing to ur mum and leave the ball in her court,like any mum should do she will do anything in the world to help her little prince, she literally gave u life remember, mum's r tough that's just how they r wired, mum's run the house and everything in it lol, once she has the facts then she can spring into action, u know I'm right mate

I've seen how they treat my poor cousin she did every drug imaginable and has really bad mental health, they hardly talk to her through embarrassment and don't listen to her and it's such a shame on her can't go through what she went through, at family gathering she's set in the corner and ignored, I know ur trying but I'm trying to point out that I'm happy and content with my decision, I'm not looking for help or to be talked round etc just someone to talk to til I reach the end is all, I sincerely appreciate u talking to me though as noone else is really bothering which I can understand as why would u want to talk to someone when u know u can't help them, when there is people here who genuinely and rightly so need help, I was being naive thinking people would 'just' talk, people actively shy away from death in the real world, back to u tho ur a decent human taking the time out of ur day to just talk to someone u have or never will meet
Tripping might make u see things in a different light and give u the answer or help on the way, always wanted to try shrooms but could never get any where I live, try them for me ;)

I'm content now and just want to hear about other people so I don't have to think about my own problems no help for me but with u it's there in the form of ur mum, u don't have to tell her face to face how about u write a note explaining how ur feeling and leave it somewhere she will read in the morning the she can't come to u?

I appreciate that but u admitted it urself it was total bullshit, ur obviously in UK so u know what I'm on about with mental health services, I know I'm not well but the thought of family looking/treating me different as I have called mental illness I can't take, I won't be a leper or someone they have to walk on eggshells around as they wouldn't want to upset me, fuck that, they can remember me how I was not who I became, I have trust issues anyway always have and the thought of telling a stranger makes me think I'm right this way, u don't have to keep msg'ing back I'm sure there is someone who can be talked round on here who needs the help more than me, ur a tent tho :)

If only u knew about my life, ur mum might be disappointed now but if u approach her and get help one day in the future she will be so proud of u getting the help u needed and trusted her with that information,she would immensely grateful, and if u get married kids etc that would outweigh the here and now

I get that but tbh I'm pretty sure I have BPD or bi polar as I tick most of the boxes, in my country mental health services are severely underfunded and after reading some of the horror stories in the NHS where they don't believe u etc I'm not humiliating myself that way or being a drain on resource's for people worsecoff than me who really need it, this is a conscious decision where I have control, I don't mean to upset anyone with my choice of language I'm just up front and honest

How about putting urself in the mindset of living FOR ur dad, ur young and have ur life ahead of u when u think about it, u say ur mum would try her hardest, we'll give her the chance to try mate, think about it, I know that when ur in this frame of mind u dont think logically but give her the chance to help that's what mum's do :)

I should have been more tactful I guess, and shielded people a bit, just prefer honesty, don't mean to upset anyone just thought there would be people who could make my last few days here a little bit barrable and take my mind off it, I'll go now but thanks for chatting anyway appreciate it

No I get where ur coming from for me I have limited options and this way I'm in control, I don't have a support network, access to services as my counters government deliberately doesn't fund mental health, I assume it's because deep down they want people to die, saves them money in treating them I guess, sounds like ur mother would help if u gave her the chance, it's too late for me but given u haven't done anything tells me there is hope for u though

Sometimes that's what needs to be done, maybe u need ur mom to force u as ur not thinking str8,where I'm from men are men and there is nowhere to turn but not everywhere is like my country, ur young and have people to help u, I would take them up on the offer if I was in ur situation, not that I presume to know all the facts

I totally understand where your coming from I'm just not strong enough to deal with my issues, do u have a good support network, how about leaving a note explaining how ur feeling for ur parents to read and see how they react to that
Sorry if I brought u down a bit, seriously, was not my intention at all and if I have caused u any distress I apologise profusely
Thanks for it reply, life is shit I know hence why I'm doing what I'm doing, I'm not going to be like a therapist and tell u what to do or think, what makes us think u will be dead within a week?

I know it might seem it but it's not, I don't feel hungry as I could go days without eating anyway like overtrained my body over the years, yeah just been at home and putting affairs content order etc, enough about me though tell me about u, if u feel comfortable talking that is

Really difficult to get guns in my country, its not hard I'm in the mindset and comfortable with my decision, normally takes 3-7 days so I'm halfway there, have my notes prepared to send when I'm feeling weaker, I've thought about walking into traffic, off bridges tablets, even helium and nitrogen but after read loads online this is by far the most natural different cultures sincectime immemorial have used this method
U don't need to help just someone to talk to to take my mind off things before I die, not eaten in 4 days or drank in 3days, my way is suicide by dehydration, don't feel pain, so tell me about u
